back through Devoran and Perran → Charlestown is 35 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

places-charlestown-st-just-mining-distri.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-charlestown-st-just-mining-distri.story: A 189 km round trip from St Austell - roughly 3 h 16 in the saddle. It goes by way of Devoran and Perran, Tregonning and Gwinear Mining Districts, St Just Mining District and back through Tregonning and Gwinear Mining Districts. The line favours views over speed.
